posts.content_md:
My part of the world had a "weather event" this past Saturday (March 23, 2024). It was originally predicted to be a dusting of snow, but ended up being something far more severe. We got a little snow, then sleet, then a lot of snow, then rain, then ice, then more snow. A lot of tree limbs came tumbling down, and they took out many power lines in the process.

We lost power Saturday evening. Power was restored about 30 hours later. If you noticed this site was unavailable during the outage, that was the reason. My apologies for any inconvenience it caused.
